Title: Aeroponics vs Hydroponics: Yields, Mist Timing & Risks
Description: Aeroponics mists bare roots; DWC and NFT keep them in solution. In trials lettuce did as well or better in DWC or NFT; aeroponics grew bigger roots. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: aeroponics vs hydroponics, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic system
